summary: Added the aac-tools entry to controllerConfig.toolchains in HelmCharts' charts/kubecoder/values.yaml: registry:5000/aac-tools:latest on a floating tag, imagePullPolicy Always, a 1Gi memory limit, no command/args, no homeOverlays and no skipParityChecks, with description and instructions covering both commands. helm template over the prd release values renders it into the controller ConfigMap and kc project test is green; the change is values-only and nothing else in the repo moved.
